limitations: Guard wall sum is supervised workflow time, not CPU time or agent effort. Parallel guard sums exceed their interval union.
Nested native/build/stage/transport timers are descriptive only and never added to outer guard totals.
Unfinished guards are excluded; later candidate acquisition is not a completed result.
Intervals outside completed guards include implementation, orchestration, unguarded work and in-progress runs; they are not measured idle time.
No model-token/quota or agent-reasoning telemetry is available here.
